title: UK Trade Mark Applications Weekly (IPO Journal Watch) — filters

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Current records (default), or only the records added, removed or changed since a date — schedule a daily run in changes mode to monitor the register and pay only for what changed.

since.title: Changes since
since.description: Changes mode only: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: the last 7 days. The feed keeps 90 days.

change.title: Change type
change.description: Changes mode only: one kind of change. Default: all three.

classes.title: Nice class
classes.description: One two-digit Nice class, e.g. 09 (software), 25 (clothing), 35 (advertising/retail), 42 (SaaS). Leave blank for all.

mark_text.title: Mark text contains
mark_text.description: Filter: mark text contains (case-insensitive substring match) — your own mark or a similar word.

applicant.title: Applicant contains
applicant.description: Applicant organisation name contains (individual applicants carry no name).

applicant_country.title: Applicant country
applicant_country.description: ISO country code or name as published, e.g. GB, US, DE.

applicant_type.title: Applicant type
applicant_type.description: organisation or individual — leave blank for all.

representative.title: Representative contains
representative.description: Trade mark attorney firm name contains.

journal_number.title: Journal issue
journal_number.description: Issue number as published, e.g. 2026/038. Leave blank for the whole rolling year.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: UK application or International registration designating the UK.

goods_services.title: Goods/services contain
goods_services.description: Filter: goods and services specification contains (case-insensitive substring match).

publication_date_after.title: Published on or after
publication_date_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD — e.g. last week's issue only

opposition_deadline_after.title: Opposition deadline on or after
opposition_deadline_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD — marks still open to opposition

max_results.title: Maximum results
max_results.description: Stop after this many records (you are charged per result).
